description: Sutra Native v1.4 — runtime activation + standalone H-Sutra producer (D49). SessionStart auto-starts the Native engine (best-effort, logs to ~/.sutra-native/native.log). Stop performs graceful teardown. UserPromptSubmit fires per-turn-h-sutra.sh: classifies utterance + writes JSONL row that Native's HSutraConnector tails. Co-installed with core@sutra: arbitration intrinsic to lib (first producer wins per-turn lock).
